results.title: Fearmongering around fake drugs
results.content: As per the last National Drug Survey published in 2017, the volume of counterfeit drugs in the Indian market detected in the survey was at a negligible 0.0245%

results.title: India needs a comprehensive doctrine on space security
results.content: India’s objective should not be to turn outer space into another arena of conflict, but to ensure that disruption in space does not translate into vulnerability on Earth

results.title: Transgender rights, healthcare should not be compromised
results.content: Clinical understanding of the care needs of a transgender person remains rudimentary in India. Doctors, nurses, receptionists, security staff and hospital administrators need to be trained in basic transgender health.

results.title: Chennai’s second airport: T.N. govt. awaits response from AAI, Ministry for site examination
results.content: The government had reached out to AAI and Civil Aviation Ministry seeking a response to the letter it sent for a pre-feasibility study for second airport; a source in Delhi says getting nod for the two shortlisted sites will be difficult as one is close to a space centre and the other is near an atomic power station
